movie.title: Kraken
movie.overview: A marine biologist is doing research on a fish farm when she encounters several strange occurrences. Along with the brutal deaths of two teenagers, all signs point to the deep fjord; can there be more to the depths than the eye can see?

reviews.author: Sierbahnn
reviews.content: After Trollhunter (2010) and the later Troll-movies (2022,2025) it is well established that Norwegian filmmakers are confident and proficient monster-builders. So also with this movie, which is a cautionary tale about meddling with nature. The casting is solid, the character-work leaves the protagonists and antagonists with motivations and relationships you can relate to, which means that the tension has stakes. The direction is good and the effects are just lovely. There are a lot of physical props to compliment the grander cgi-pieces, and it all blends very well together. I enjoyed this a lot.

aiEnrichment.summary_one_sentence: When a marine biologist investigating unusual events on a fish farm connects them to the gruesome deaths of two teenagers, she uncovers a terrifying secret lurking in the depths of a local fjord.
aiEnrichment.summary_short: A dedicated marine biologist conducting routine research on a fish farm finds her study derailed by a series of unsettling anomalies in the surrounding waters. The tension escalates dramatically following the brutal, unexplainable deaths of two local teenagers near the shore. Realizing these events are connected, she turns her focus to the dark, isolated fjord to uncover what is emerging from the abyss. As panic spreads, she must race against time to reveal the ancient, monstrous presence hidden beneath the surface before it strikes again.
aiEnrichment.summary_long: While carrying out ecological research at a remote fish farm, a marine biologist begins noticing bizarre biological readings and abnormal animal behavior in the surrounding water. Her growing suspicion that something is wrong is tragically confirmed when two teenagers are brutally slaughtered near the edge of the fjord under mysterious circumstances. As local authorities struggle to make sense of the carnage, the biologist analyzes environmental data and traces the origin of the violent encounters directly to the deepest trench of the fjord. Her investigation reveals that acoustic disturbances and human activity have awakened an ancient, predatory creature long thought to be mere maritime folklore. Driven by scientific curiosity and a need to protect the town, she ventures deeper into the aquatic hazard zone to track the monster's movements. Tensions peak as the creature begins hunting closer to shore, threatening both the fish farm and the innocent inhabitants of the coastal community. Working alongside reluctant locals, she scrambles to devise a plan to contain or destroy the organism before its rampage becomes unstoppable. Ultimately, her voyage into the abyss forces her to confront not only a relentless nightmare from the deep, but the terrifying reality of what happens when humanity disturbs unexplored ecosystems.
aiEnrichment.synopsis: Set against the eerie, isolated backdrop of a coastal fjord, Kraken follows a marine biologist whose routine study at a local fish farm plunges her into a desperate fight for survival. After observing a series of disturbing ecological anomalies, her fears are realized when two local teenagers suffer a violent and inexplicable demise near the water's edge. Clues point toward the dark, unmapped depths of the fjord, suggesting that a legendary, predatory force has been disturbed from its slumber. Combining elements of creature-feature horror, tense action, and dramatic suspense, the film explores the terrifying collision between modern human industry and the primordial mysteries hidden within the ocean's depths.
